item.title: Generate and apply database migrations without leaving IntelliJ IDEA
item.description: You rename a field on a JPA entity. Then you leave the editor to write the SQL, write the rollback script, check which database you are about to change, and run it. The Migrax plugin for IntelliJ IDEA keeps all of that in the IDE. This article follows one renamed field from the edit to the applied migration.
